title: Sell Mineral Rights in Powhatan Point, OH
primaryKeyword: sell mineral rights powhatan point oh
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Powhatan Point, OH | Belmont County
metaDescription: Powhatan Point sits along the Ohio River in Belmont County's Utica core. Learn how nearby heavy drilling affects a mineral rights sale here.
heroLead: Powhatan Point sits along the Ohio River in Belmont County, inside one of the most productive parts of Ohio's Utica/Point Pleasant core, in an area that has seen sustained horizontal drilling for well over a decade.
intro: Belmont County drives a large share of Ohio's total Utica production, and Powhatan Point's location along the river puts it within reach of some of the county's most active drilling corridors. If you own mineral rights here, there's a real chance nearby units already have strong, well-documented production history.

sections.heading: River-corridor drilling activity near Powhatan Point
paragraphs: Operators have built out extensive drilling programs along the Ohio River corridor in Belmont County, with names like Gulfport Energy, Ascent Resources, and now Encino Energy holding acreage in the area. If your parcel is inside one of these units, your division order will show your exact decimal interest.

sections.heading: What strong local data means for valuation
paragraphs: Because Belmont County has such an established production track record, a buyer evaluating a Powhatan Point-area interest can rely on real, nearby well data rather than speculation. That typically makes for more confident offers, whether your interest is already producing or still unleased near an active unit.

sections.heading: Checking records at the Belmont County Recorder
paragraphs: The Belmont County Recorder's office in St. Clairsville holds lease, unit, and deed records for Powhatan Point-area land. Confirm your unit status and lease history there before entering any sale conversation.

faqs.question: Is Powhatan Point in an active part of the Utica play?
faqs.answer: Yes, it sits within Belmont County's heavily drilled river corridor, one of the strongest production areas in the entire Utica/Point Pleasant play.

faqs.question: Which operators are active near Powhatan Point?
faqs.answer: Gulfport Energy and Ascent Resources have both held acreage in this area, with much of the legacy leasehold now consolidated under Encino Energy.

faqs.question: How do I check my unit status?
faqs.answer: The Belmont County Recorder's office in St. Clairsville holds unit and lease designations for the area. If a well is producing on your unit, you should also have a division order on file.

faqs.question: How current should my royalty statements be for an accurate offer?
faqs.answer: Bring at least the last six months, and ideally a full year, so a buyer can see both current volume and the well's decline trend rather than a single snapshot.

faqs.question: Does being close to the river add any complications to a mineral rights sale?
faqs.answer: Not usually for the oil and gas rights themselves, though river-adjacent parcels sometimes have separate considerations around flood easements or right-of-way grants that are worth reviewing alongside your mineral title.
